notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {8}{R}{G}{G}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}{R}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
